testsuite.name: gRPC — unary, streaming, metadata and the error path

testcase.name: unary — one request, one response
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'Hello' * session.send({ name: 'John' }) * session.pop() == { message: 'hello John' }

testcase.name: request metadata, and reading the response metadata back
the error path — an empty name is rejected
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'Hello' * session.send({ name: '' }) * session.collect() == [] * session.status == 'INVALID_ARGUMENT'

testcase.name: server streaming — collect a known number of responses
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'LotsOfReplies' * = 3 * session.send({ name: 'John' }) * session.collect() == [{ message: 'hello John 1' }, { message: 'hello John 2' }, { message: 'hello John 3' }]

testcase.name: client streaming — many requests, one response
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'LotsOfGreetings' * = true * session.send({ name: 'John' }) * session.send({ name: 'Smith' }) * session.flush() * session.pop() == { message: 'hello [John, Smith]' }

testcase.name: bidirectional streaming — a response per request on one open stream
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'BidiHello' * = true * = 3 * session.send({ name: 'John' }) * session.send({ name: 'Smith' }) * session.send({ name: 'Jane' }) * session.collect() ==
